critical_code_review_comments: Config hardening gap: backend/core/config.py defines default FRONTEND_URL/BACKEND_URL values; this weakens fail-fast env validation guidance for URL config.
Maintainability risk: frontend/src/App.js is very large (~1300+ lines), above module-size guideline, increasing regression probability in route-heavy changes.
